notes.title: Elfie: A Sand Plan Demo Release Date - August 7th
notes.content:
And it's part of the Wholesome Games Celebration!! 

I'm super happy to announce that not only will the demo for Elfie: A Sand Plan be released on August 7th, but also that it will be part of the "New Demos" section of the Wholesome Games Celebration!!

The event starts August 7th and lasts until the 14th!
I'm excited to see all the other lineup of games showcased alongside Elfie. And have fun checking out the event!

"And playing our demo hehe", you hear Elfie whisper in the background.
